required_invariants.description: When sender_blocked.pause or equivalent circuit condition exists, no unsafe submission occurs and the worker remains stopped/blocked as designed.
Rolling hard-bounce safety threshold and breaker behavior must be computed from real provider/ledger evidence and enforced.
Queue submissions, provider acceptance, external ledger and rolling quota must reconcile without duplicates or unsafe stale sending states.
Worker singleton ownership, restart behavior and circuit-breaker recovery must be proven without bypassing stop-the-line.
